Interface ObservableConfig<T extends AbstractConfig<?>>

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractSubsystem, Feature, FeatureConfig, KamiCommon, KamiConfig, KamiConfigExt, KamiPlugin, Module, ModuleConfig, StandaloneConfig, StandaloneConfigExt, SubsystemConfig
public interface ObservableConfig<T extends AbstractConfig<?>>
Interface for classes that accept ConfigObserver registrations.

See registerConfigObserver(ConfigObserver).
